answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Gym membership tenure with club attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 704 aliases would need 704 separate proofs, each costing about 113 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The beacon sits in the mechanism itself, the thread sits in the price of faking it, and the opal sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
